sloka: सीता लक्ष्मीर्भवान् विष्णुर्देवः कृष्णः प्रजापतिः ।वधार्थं रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम् ।। ६.१२०.२९ ।।
transliteration: sītā lakṣmīrbhavān viṣṇurdevaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।vadhārthaṁ rāvaṇasyeha praviṣṭo mānuṣīṁ tanum ।। 6.120.29 ।।

translations.english: "Rama you are the supreme and upholder of dharma. The purpose for which you are born has been accomplished. Ravana is killed. You return to your abode happily."
